name: text-rack-focus
title: Rack Focus
description: Hai dòng chữ ở hai độ sâu, tiêu điểm chuyển từ dòng xa sang dòng gần: dòng này nhoè 8 px thì dòng kia rõ lại.

moworks.author: takayu

options.blur: px on the line out of focus (16)
options.start: the line in focus at the start

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-rack-focus, written here): Two lines at different depths: far (≈0.6× size, upper left, dimmer) and near (large, lower right). Focus pull: the sharp line blurs 0 → 8 px and dims (opacity ~0.6–0.7) while the other goes 8 → 0 px and full, 1.2 s ease-in-out (cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); GSAP power2.inOut; recipe range 0.8–1.5 s). Demo: starts on far, pull to near 0.6–1.8 s, hold, back 3.1–4.3 s; loop 5 s (GSAP yoyo with 1.3 s holds). Params: duration: chuyển nét (1.2 s) · blur (8 px) · dim: độ mờ dòng nhoè (0.6) · hold (1.3 s).
moworks.titleVi: Chuyển nét giữa hai dòng chữ
